notes: Codex-only routing cases. Positives cover sidebar titles, same-repository relevance, and scheduled organization. Negatives protect other clients, generic Git cleanup, and ordinary conversation summaries. The held_out split is the final untouched test set, matching the repository's active-skill eval convention.

train.query: Review my recent Codex tasks and propose better sidebar titles from the full conversation bodies
Compare all Codex conversations for this repo and tell me which older work was superseded
Apply the approved Codex title manifest and verify every title by reading it back
Create a periodic Codex automation that organizes changed tasks using our sparse emoji taxonomy
Mark the single most important unfinished Codex task red and concrete follow-up tasks yellow
Rename this Git branch and clean up stale files
Organize my ChatGPT web conversation history
Add emoji names to my Claude Code sessions

validation.query: Use Codex task history to find duplicates and durable completed references for this repository
Put a verified completion check mark on the Codex titles whose outcomes were actually checked
Recommend which completed or superseded Codex tasks are archive candidates without archiving them yet
Summarize this one conversation without changing or organizing my Codex sidebar

held_out.query: Audit the Codex tasks for this project family; age alone must not mean obsolete
Make waiting, blocked, canonical, and superseded Codex tasks visually distinct in the sidebar
Build a browser extension that renames chat tabs
